C0932.title: Black-market intermediary Gao forged official agency seals; case cracked with Mashang Consumer Finance assisting police
C0932.summary: In September 2021, black-market intermediary Gao collected over 30,000 yuan in service fees from a client, then repeatedly impersonated the client to file complaints with Mashang Consumer Finance and regulatory authorities.
